title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard tape of a high‑energy MSG gig with a smoking Shakedown Street and strong second‑set gems like Scarlet/Fire, Terrapin and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The show bursts open with a 12‑minute inspired Shakedown Street and delivers memorable moments from El Paso to the rare Dupree’s Diamond Blues. The second set stays solid through a big‑fat Scarlet/Fire, Terrapin Station and a plaintive Stella Blue, while the tape remains clean enough to capture the crowd electricity of an MSG night.

ai_rating.rationale: Review highlights strong musical performance with many standout songs and a clean recording, but only one review limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean tape with good balance and crowd ambience; no major flaws noted.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set packed with highlights; second set solid after a brief bridge slip, maintaining momentum to the finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: 12‑minute inspired guitar showcase noted as a highlight.
band_member_comments.Bob: Staggered vocals mentioned on several songs.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's vocal contributions and nice intro on Man Smart Woman Smarter are praised.
